Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the chemical reaction between hydrochloric acid (HCl) and sodium hydroxide (NaOH). Instead of recognizing this as a standard acid-base neutralization reaction producing sodium chloride (NaCl) and water (H2O), the Planner hallucinated the products as "H2Cl2" and "NaOH2". This is a fundamental error in chemical knowledge, leading to a completely wrong conclusion and an incorrect selection of option D.
